name: Ferruginous-Psalter
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by towering mountain ranges. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
